brands.name: Curaprox
brands.tagline: Gentle daily care patients actually stick with.
brands.blurb: Swiss oral care built around ultra-fine filaments — cleaning that is thorough without being harsh on gums or enamel.
about: Curaprox makes the brushes, interdental picks and rinses hygienists hand to patients when compliance matters more than force. The CS 5460 packs 5,460 ultra-fine Curen filaments into one head, so plaque comes off with pressure gentle enough for sensitive and recently treated gums.
Stock it chairside as the take-home half of every prophy appointment — patients keep using what feels good, and recall visits get easier.

whyChoose.title: Ultra-fine Curen filaments
whyChoose.body: Thorough plaque removal at a pressure gentle enough for sensitive and recently treated gums.

whyChoose.title: Interdental sizing system
whyChoose.body: Colour-coded sizes make it easy to fit each patient accurately at the chair.

whyChoose.title: Strong retail margin
whyChoose.body: A take-home range clinics can stock profitably alongside treatment.

cta.heading: Interested in learning more?
cta.body: Talk to our team about clinic pricing and take-home stocking for Curaprox.

brands.name: Herculite
brands.tagline: The composite that set the standard for natural polish.
brands.blurb: A restorative benchmark for decades — nano-hybrid handling, lifelike shading and a polish that holds.
about: Herculite composites are the shorthand for predictable anterior and posterior restorations: they stay where you place them, sculpt without slumping, and finish to a natural lustre that survives years of brushing.
The balanced filler system keeps polymerization shrinkage low, which means fewer marginal gaps and less post-operative sensitivity to explain to the patient.

whyChoose.title: Nano-hybrid filler
whyChoose.body: High strength paired with a lifelike polish that holds up over years of brushing.

whyChoose.title: Low shrinkage
whyChoose.body: Tighter margins and less post-operative sensitivity to explain to the patient.

whyChoose.title: VITA-matched shading
whyChoose.body: Consistent shade matching across the whole range.

cta.heading: Interested in learning more?
cta.body: Ask our team about the full Herculite restorative range and clinic pricing.

brands.name: Kavoo
brands.tagline: Clinic equipment and handpieces built to last.
brands.blurb: Chairs, handpieces and clinic hardware chosen for daily throughput — the pieces you only want to buy once.
about: Kavoo covers the hardware your day actually runs on: handpieces, chairs, compressors and suction. These are long-cycle purchases, so the selection here leans toward serviceable units with parts availability in the Philippines rather than the cheapest sticker price.
Talk to our team before you buy — we will size the compressor and suction to your number of chairs so you are not retrofitting a year in.

whyChoose.title: Local parts support
whyChoose.body: High- and low-speed handpieces we can actually service in the Philippines.

whyChoose.title: Sized to your clinic
whyChoose.body: Chairs, compressors and HV suction specified against your number of chairs.

whyChoose.title: Installation included
whyChoose.body: Delivery, installation and servicing arranged nationwide.

cta.heading: Interested in learning more?
cta.body: Book a consultation and we'll spec the equipment to your operatory count.

brands.name: Kerr
brands.tagline: Restorative materials trusted chairside for generations.
brands.blurb: One of dentistry's most established material houses — bonding, endodontics, finishing and everything in between.
about: Kerr has been supplying operatories for over a century, and the range shows it: bonding agents, cements, endodontic files and obturation, finishing and polishing systems that clinicians already know how to use.
For a practice standardizing its restorative protocol, Kerr is the safe spine to build on — consistent chemistry across the steps, with documentation to match.

whyChoose.title: The full restorative chain
whyChoose.body: Bond, fill, finish and polish with chemistry designed to work together.

whyChoose.title: Endodontics covered
whyChoose.body: Files, sealers and obturation from a single trusted source.

whyChoose.title: Documented protocols
whyChoose.body: Established clinical protocols your team can standardize on.

cta.heading: Interested in learning more?
cta.body: Ask about bulk pricing on Kerr restorative and endodontic lines.

brands.name: Lasotronix
brands.tagline: Precision diode lasers for everyday clinical work.
brands.blurb: European-built diode laser systems for soft-tissue surgery, endodontic disinfection, periodontics and whitening.
about: Lasotronix diode systems put multiple wavelengths and preset clinical programs into a compact chairside unit, so one investment covers gingivectomy, frenectomy, pocket disinfection, endodontic decontamination and laser whitening.
Because diode energy seals as it cuts, soft-tissue procedures run with less bleeding and faster healing — often with the patient walking out sutureless.

whyChoose.title: Multi-wavelength platform
whyChoose.body: One unit with clinical presets covering surgery, endodontics, perio and whitening.

whyChoose.title: Minimal bleeding
whyChoose.body: Diode energy seals as it cuts, so soft-tissue cases heal faster and often sutureless.

whyChoose.title: Disinfection protocols
whyChoose.body: Documented endodontic and periodontal decontamination programs.

cta.heading: Interested in learning more?
cta.body: Book a demo and try the unit on your own clinical cases.

brands.name: Philips Zoom
brands.tagline: Whiter teeth — without hurting your enamel.
brands.blurb: The most requested whitening system in the world, with enamel-protective chemistry and clinically visible results in one visit.
about: Philips Zoom pairs an in-chair light-activated session with take-home trays, so patients see the change on the day and hold it for months. The gels carry ACP and potassium nitrate to protect enamel and blunt the sensitivity that puts people off whitening entirely.
For most clinics this is the easiest cosmetic service to introduce: patients already ask for it by name.

whyChoose.title: Results in one visit
whyChoose.body: A visible shade change in a single chairside session patients can see the same day.

whyChoose.title: Enamel-protective
whyChoose.body: ACP and potassium nitrate blunt the sensitivity that puts people off whitening.

whyChoose.title: In-office plus take-home
whyChoose.body: Trays maintain the result for months and bring the patient back.

cta.heading: Interested in learning more?
cta.body: Ask us how to add Zoom whitening to your service list.

brands.name: Rundeer
brands.tagline: Scan a full arch in 30 seconds.
brands.blurb: Fast, lightweight intraoral scanners that make digital impressions quicker than the alginate they replace.
about: Rundeer scanners are built around speed: a full arch captures in about 30 seconds, so the scan is finished before a nervous patient has time to gag. Lightweight wands and an open workflow keep the learning curve short for the whole team.
Open STL output means your existing lab can accept the case immediately — no proprietary lock-in, no per-case export fee.

whyChoose.title: ~30-second full arch
whyChoose.body: The scan finishes before a nervous patient has time to gag.

whyChoose.title: Short learning curve
whyChoose.body: A lightweight wand the whole team picks up in an afternoon.

whyChoose.title: Open STL export
whyChoose.body: Works with the lab you already use — no lock-in, no per-case fee.

cta.heading: Interested in learning more?
cta.body: Book a scanner demo at your clinic.

brands.name: SOL Laser
brands.blurb: An accessible entry point into laser dentistry — compact systems and training for clinics adding their first laser.
about: SOL is where most practices begin with lasers. The units are compact and portable enough to move between operatories, and the preset programs mean you can perform your first soft-tissue procedures without a long calibration ritual.
We pair every SOL system with onboarding so the laser gets used from week one instead of sitting in a cupboard.

whyChoose.title: Compact and portable
whyChoose.body: Small enough to move between operatories as your day demands.

whyChoose.title: Preset programs
whyChoose.body: Common soft-tissue procedures without a long calibration ritual.

whyChoose.title: Training included
whyChoose.body: Onboarding so the laser gets used from week one.

cta.heading: Interested in learning more?
cta.body: Talk to us about starting your laser dentistry journey.

brands.name: Sprintray
brands.tagline: Ready for a transformative digital workflow.
brands.blurb: Scanning, 3D printing and same-day chairside production — the complete digital pipeline for a modern clinic.
about: Sprintray closes the loop between scan and delivery. Capture with an intraoral scanner, design chairside, print the night guard, model, surgical guide or temporary crown in the same visit — the patient leaves with the appliance instead of a follow-up appointment.
This is the brand to talk to when the goal is not one gadget but a workflow: fewer lab turnarounds, fewer remakes, and a visible jump in what the practice can offer.

whyChoose.title: Intraoral and facial scanning
whyChoose.body: Capture the whole case digitally, from arch to full face.

whyChoose.title: Same-day appliances
whyChoose.body: Chairside printing means the patient leaves with the appliance, not an appointment.

whyChoose.title: Validated resins
whyChoose.body: Tested materials for night guards, models and surgical guides.
